controls.statement: Read AGENTS.md and git status before broad changes; preserve local modifications.
Confirm capabilities in current code instead of trusting historical plans.
Keep main.py as the temporary composition root.
Do not change Gemini protocol, audio, and UI in the same refactor.
Keep legacy adapters until functional equivalence is proven.
Do not expose secrets, OAuth material, certificates, memory, or sensitive logs.
Require confirmation, preview, and rollback when possible for destructive operations.
Record motivation, files, risks, tests, metrics, and rollback for every change.
Update the Obsidian note and change log.
Do not mark work complete without verifying real behavior.
Identify the unique owner of changed state.
State whether the route always passes through PermissionPolicy.
Describe how the real effect is verified.
Describe how the change is reverted.
Describe cancellation, timeout, expiry, and reconnection behavior.
State whether Gemini and UI compatibility is preserved.
Record the metric that demonstrates improvement.
Justify every new abstraction by duplication, authority, effect verification, or testability.

changes.title: Global acceptance gate
changes.motivation: Turn section 15 into a fail-closed evidence inventory and close the durable-persistence gap.
changes.objective: Track all global acceptance criteria without claiming unresolved work as verified.

tests.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_memory_manager.py tests/test_memory_atomic.py tests/test_runtime_state.py tests/test_global_acceptance.py

metrics: Fault injection preserves the last complete primary or validated backup.
changes.rollback: Revert the phase commit; restore only a validated memory primary or backup while JARVIS is stopped.
changes.owner: Global acceptance inventory: scripts/check_global_acceptance.py; memory: memory.memory_manager; runtime telemetry: core.runtime_state.
changes.effect_verification: Matrix integrity and strict-mode exit codes plus filesystem fault-injection tests.
changes.cancellation_timeout_reconnect: No long-running work was introduced; atomic temporary cleanup is bounded by one local write.
changes.compatibility: Gemini protocol, audio, UI, and legacy adapters were unchanged.
changes.limitations: No hardware, accounts, network, or interprocess memory writer was exercised.

changes.title: Operational change control
changes.motivation: Make the PDF operational instructions and pre-refactor questions enforceable for future architectural phases.
changes.objective: Require structured evidence for every completed phase from phase 15 onward.
risks: A structured record can validate completeness but cannot prove that an operator actually read AGENTS.md.
The external Obsidian note remains a documented manual check in CI.
metrics: Completed phases from the enforcement floor must have exactly one structured change record.
changes.rollback: Remove the operational gate call and its files; runtime behavior is unaffected.
changes.effect_verification: The gate rejects missing controls, missing phase records, unsafe evidence paths, incomplete answers, and unjustified abstractions.
changes.cancellation_timeout_reconnect: The local read-only gate has no worker, retry, reconnect, or external timeout.
changes.compatibility: No production runtime, Gemini, audio, UI, or legacy adapter is modified.
changes.limitations: Manual operator actions and the external Obsidian file cannot be proven by repository-only CI.

changes.title: Audit methodology and scope closure
changes.motivation: Preserve the section 17 snapshot sources and limits while preventing a false claim of complete global acceptance.
changes.objective: Close the PDF execution sequence with a reproducible source, limitation, and residual-risk manifest.
risks: A source inventory verifies presence, not semantic completeness of every file.
Thirteen global acceptance criteria remain partial or manual.

tests.result: 5 passed; 12 passed across audit and operational gates

metrics: 8 snapshot source groups and 5 explicit limits inventoried.
changes.rollback: Remove the closure gate call and revert its manifest, script, test, and documentation; runtime remains unchanged.
changes.effect_verification: The gate resolves every source/evidence path and cross-checks closure status against the global acceptance matrix.
changes.cancellation_timeout_reconnect: The read-only local gate has no worker, retry, reconnect, or external timeout.
changes.compatibility: No runtime, Gemini, audio, UI, tool, or legacy adapter is modified.
changes.limitations: File presence does not replace semantic review; hardware, accounts, network, and destructive effects remain untested.
